title: Agent Workflow umbrella registration and maintenance workflow

maintenance.cycle_identity: task revision plus project revision plus worktree digest
maintenance.ordering: coordinator, runtime, quality, guidance, ui, release, self_evolution
maintenance.compatibility: exact specification and protocol digests are required
maintenance.self_evolution: propose follow-up ARs; never self-approve authority or completion

failure_semantics.side_effects: No Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, UI, Git, provider, network, LLM, publication, release, or durable-state operation is performed.

privacy.allowed_values: bounded identifiers, phase/status enumerations, booleans, versions, and SHA-256 digests

limitations: A passing record registers and evaluates supplied observations; it does not update the family umbrella or any authoritative repository.
Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, and UI decisions remain external observations and are not manufactured by this runtime contract.
Release and remote observations remain unperformed or unverified; exact-head evidence is supplied, not independently verified.
Self-evolution records follow-up proposals only; it cannot rewrite this specification or approve its own changes.
follow_up: Independent AWQ qualification and review are required before publication or durable-state completion.
Future ARs may bind concrete hosted integrations only after their authority and privacy contracts are approved.
